name: Do I need a building permit to remove walls for an open floor plan?

mainEntity.name: Do I need a building permit to remove walls for an open floor plan?

acceptedAnswer.text: In most cases, yes. Removing any wall that supports ceiling joists, roof rafters, or a second story requires a structural alteration permit from your local county or city building department. Permitting ensures that the replacement header beam and support footings meet structural safety codes. Even for non-load-bearing walls, permits are generally required if electrical circuits, plumbing pipes, or HVAC vents inside the wall are altered or relocated. Licensed contractors pull these permits and schedule mandatory rough-in and final inspections.
acceptedAnswer.description: Yes, permits are required for removing load-bearing walls and for any project that involves relocating electrical, plumbing, or mechanical lines.
